provenance.summary: This document summarizes various announced and implemented price cuts for Novo Nordisk's GLP-1 drugs (Wegovy, Ozempic, Rybelsus) in the U.S., including WAC cuts, Trump/TrumpRx deals, and self-pay reductions, alongside competitive market share data for Q4 2025.

This document details Novo Nordisk's announced GLP-1 price reductions in the US, effective January 1, 2027, along with prior self-pay discounts and the Trump administration's TrumpRx initiative. It also outlines the landscape of Medicaid GLP-1 obesity coverage as of January 2026, noting a contraction from 16 to 13 states, specific state policy changes, and the optional nature of this coverage for states.

This web research document compiles data on GLP-1 adoption rates, employer coverage trends, premium impact simulations, Medicare coverage status, and state-level access gaps, citing various industry and government sources.
